evals.prompt: 我在一台新的 Linux 服务器上，想给当前项目配置 model-selector，用阿里通义的 qwen3.7-max 做主模型，qwen3.6-flash 做子模型，API 地址是 https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic，effort 设为 max。另外再加一个 DeepSeek 的 deepseek-v4-pro 做主模型，deepseek-v4-flash 做子模型。不需要 apiKeyHelper，用 OAuth 就行。
evals.expected_output: Should create .claude/model-selector with 2 providers, write claude() function to ~/.bashrc, skip apiKeyHelper and secrets.sh setup, validate JSON, and remind about gitignore

assertions.name: model-selector-json-valid
assertions.description: The .claude/model-selector file exists and is valid JSON

assertions.name: model-selector-has-2-providers
assertions.description: The model-selector JSON contains exactly 2 provider entries

assertions.name: qwen-model-correct
assertions.description: Qwen entry has model='qwen3.7-max', fast='qwen3.6-flash', base_url correct

assertions.name: deepseek-model-correct
assertions.description: DeepSeek entry has model='deepseek-v4-pro', fast='deepseek-v4-flash', base_url correct

assertions.name: effort-set-to-max
assertions.description: The effort field is set to 'max' for providers

assertions.name: bashrc-function-exists
assertions.description: The bashrc file contains a claude() function definition

assertions.name: bashrc-uses-bash-read-syntax
assertions.description: The function uses bash read syntax, not zsh syntax

assertions.name: no-apikeyhelper-configured
assertions.description: No apiKeyHelper is configured (user declined)

assertions.name: no-secrets-sh-created
assertions.description: No secrets.sh file is created (user chose OAuth)

assertions.name: env-mapping-complete
assertions.description: The shell function exports all 8 required environment variables

evals.prompt: I'm on macOS and I want to set up model-selector for my project. I want to use a custom API provider at https://my-internal-api.company.com/v1/anthropic with model 'internal-gpt4o' and no separate fast model. Also add the standard Qwen provider. I DO want apiKeyHelper enabled with secrets.sh for token management. Set effort to high for the custom provider and leave it default for Qwen.
evals.expected_output: Should detect zsh, create .claude/model-selector with 2 providers, write zsh-compatible claude() to ~/.zshrc, create ~/.claude/secrets.sh with 600 permissions, add apiKeyHelper to settings.json, validate everything

assertions.name: model-selector-json-valid
assertions.description: The .claude/model-selector file exists and is valid JSON

assertions.name: model-selector-has-2-providers
assertions.description: The model-selector JSON contains exactly 2 provider entries

assertions.name: custom-provider-no-fast-field
assertions.description: Custom provider entry has no 'fast' field

assertions.name: custom-provider-effort-high
assertions.description: Custom provider has effort='high'

assertions.name: qwen-provider-no-effort
assertions.description: Qwen provider has no effort field

assertions.name: zshrc-function-exists
assertions.description: The .zshrc file contains a claude() function definition

assertions.name: zshrc-uses-zsh-read-syntax
assertions.description: The function uses zsh read syntax

assertions.name: apikeyhelper-configured
assertions.description: settings.json contains apiKeyHelper field

assertions.name: secrets-sh-created
assertions.description: secrets.sh file is created with placeholder tokens

assertions.name: secrets-sh-has-placeholders
assertions.description: secrets.sh contains placeholder tokens for providers

assertions.name: security-reminders-given
assertions.description: Output mentions 600 permissions and never-commit warning

evals.prompt: 我的项目已经有 model-selector 了，但是我想重新配置，只保留一个 glm-5.1 的模型，用智谱的 API，base url 是 https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/anthropic，主模型 glm-5.1，快速模型 glm-4.7-flash。之前的 bashrc 里已经有 claude() 函数了，帮我替换掉。
evals.expected_output: Should detect existing claude() function in bashrc, ask user before replacing, overwrite .claude/model-selector with single GLM entry, replace the old function, and verify the setup

assertions.name: model-selector-overwritten
assertions.description: The .claude/model-selector is replaced with only 1 provider entry

assertions.name: glm-model-correct
assertions.description: GLM entry has correct model, fast, and base_url

assertions.name: bashrc-function-replaced
assertions.description: The bashrc has exactly one claude() function (not duplicated)

assertions.name: bashrc-other-content-preserved
assertions.description: Other bashrc content is preserved

assertions.name: detected-existing-function
assertions.description: Transcript shows existing function was detected

assertions.name: json-valid
assertions.description: The model-selector JSON is valid

assertions.name: env-mapping-complete
assertions.description: The shell function exports all required environment variables
